categories.main_business_segments: Pool Corporation operates as the world's largest wholesale distributor of swimming pool supplies, equipment, and related leisure products, and is also a leading distributor of irrigation and landscape products in the United States. Its operations are organized through five distribution networks: SCP Distributors, Superior Pool Products, Horizon Distributors, National Pool Tile (NPT), and Sun Wholesale Supply. The company serves both residential and commercial markets, with a focus on maintenance, repair, refurbishment, and new construction of pools and outdoor environments.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: POOL leverages advanced distribution and inventory management technologies, including warehouse management systems, online ordering platforms (Pool360, Horizon 24/7), and mobile ordering tools (BlueStreak). The company also utilizes virtual design tools such as the NPT Backyard app for pool and outdoor space customization. Its operations emphasize efficient logistics, capacity creation, and the use of technology to optimize product selection, inventory, and customer service.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves approximately 120,000 customers, primarily small, family-owned businesses such as swimming pool remodelers and builders, specialty retailers, pool repair and service businesses, irrigation and landscape contractors, and commercial customers (e.g., hotels, universities, community facilities). The majority of sales are to the residential market, but commercial and specialty retail segments are also significant.
categories.geographic_coverage: POOL operates 410 sales centers across North America, Europe, and Australia. Its primary markets are in the United States, especially California, Texas, Florida, and Arizona, which together account for about 53% of net sales. In 2021, 94% of sales were in North America, 5% in Europe, and 1% in Australia, with ongoing expansion both domestically and internationally.
categories.supply_chain_position: POOL functions as a downstream distributor, purchasing products from a large number of manufacturers and distributing them to a fragmented customer base. The company adds value by aggregating products and offering favorable purchasing conditions, logistics, and support services to its customers, who typically lack the scale to buy directly from manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include promoting industry and customer growth, expanding product offerings (especially in energy-efficient and sustainable products), and improving operational effectiveness through technology and process innovation. The company invests in digital tools, showrooms, and private label/exclusive products, and pursues growth through acquisitions and new sales center openings. R&D is focused on supporting new product introductions, sustainability, and digital customer engagement.
categories.revenue_model: POOL generates revenue primarily through the sale and distribution of a broad range of pool, irrigation, landscape, and outdoor living products. Revenue streams include product sales to contractors, retailers, and commercial customers, as well as private label and exclusive brand offerings. The company also benefits from recurring revenue tied to pool maintenance and repair products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: POOL is the largest and only truly national wholesale distributor focused on the swimming pool industry in the U.S., and a leading distributor in irrigation and landscape products. It faces competition from regional and local distributors, one national landscape supply distributor, mass market retailers (including internet-based), and large pool supply retailers. Barriers to entry are relatively low, but POOL's scale, breadth of products, and service capabilities provide a competitive advantage.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2021, POOL reported net sales of $5.3 billion, a 35% increase over 2020, with net income of $650.6 million (up 77% year-over-year). The company has demonstrated strong growth driven by robust demand, market share gains, and acquisitions. Gross margin improved to 30.5%, and the company continues to invest in expansion, technology, and inventory to support future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: POOL's value proposition centers on its comprehensive product selection (over 200,000 SKUs), high service levels, local inventory availability, digital tools, and support programs for customers. The company differentiates itself through its scale, exclusive and private label products, technology-enabled customer experience, and ability to provide one-stop solutions for pool, irrigation, and outdoor living needs. Its recurring revenue from maintenance and repair products adds stability and resilience.
